modelingFreedom: Native forms, proportions, construction, topology/part counts and purposeful decoration may improve materially. Source weak geometry/body coordinates are not immutable. Camera/root, footprint, actual functional clearance, rig/rest/actions/timing and contact transforms remain locked.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: Native rounded form language replaces the flat primitive impression: the yellow folded cap has intentional crown/brim volume and controlled edge thickness; face, nose/ears, moustache and hair form coherent soft masses; shirt/collar/teal insert, palms, trousers and shoes read as a designed whole. Useful design improvements are rewarded, including changed proportions within functional envelope. Front target features inspire outcomes; unseen views must be coherent rather than identical inventions.
rankedAestheticCriteria.failures: A material-only recolor that leaves dominant weak primitive construction; melted/flattened facial features; rear or side heads/cap becoming unconsidered slabs; disconnected garment or limb parts.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: Keep medium tan skin, blue-black hair/moustache, yellow folded cap, green shirt/teal panel, navy trousers and dark shoes. Warm soft rendering differentiates these families; navy and hair preserve volume and separation at intended size.
rankedAestheticCriteria.failures: Palette drift, lime/neon clipping, uniformly orange skin, near-black garment/hair holes, muddy merged greens/teal.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: Broad gentle highlights and soft form/contact shading describe volume without a preferred horizontal light direction, directional ground shadow or camera-dependent lighting edits. All cardinal facings feel part of the same warm softly lit cartoon family.
rankedAestheticCriteria.failures: Hard bright edge tracing, narrow plastic glints over large areas, blown yellow/skin, black seam bands, one-facing dark dead spots or ground-shadow direction.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: Selective garment/cap construction detail and controlled eye/skin relief enrich the native model where legible. Materials feel soft and tactile. Fine target grain, halo and pixel artifacts carry no authority.
rankedAestheticCriteria.failures: Noisy procedural speckle, busy seams/buttons, protruding detached trim, uniform rough blobs without construction, copied ImageGen edge glow.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: At logical192x320 and native384x640, Samir, the expression, cap/hair profile, hand gestures and main garment divisions remain clear. All 10main+2supplemental actions preserve recognizable movement, clean sitting/eating contacts and coherent view changes. Canonical2D food remains plausible in body occlusion without moving its screen support/scale.
rankedAestheticCriteria.failures: Tiny features vanish or sparkle, hands merge into shirt/head, food clips through opaque body to force exposure, eating motions miss the visible meal/mouth, seating floats or clips, seated frame cropped by standing-only bounds.

rankedAestheticCriteria.success: All required samples have clean alpha, stable surface normals, no accidental overlaps/seams, holes, z-fighting, exposed cut ends, stray geometry, flicker, texture swimming or hard material patches. Review light/gray/dark backgrounds and actual12fps playback, not contact sheets alone.
rankedAestheticCriteria.failures: Any material defect in a required facing/state, missing temporal evidence, old-style body/food overlays still active or painted/warped final pixels.

Coordinates are edges, not pixel centers. UV uses bottom-origin v=1-y/H. Use alpha>=128 primary; 64/192 sensitivity is descriptive, not three selectable mappings.
